messages:
kai: Hi team — filing an accommodation request. I have chronic lower-back pain and my doc recommends an adjustable sit-stand desk and mid-back lumbar support chair. Intake submitted via HR link.

accom-bot: HR case HR-2026-1210 created: 'Ergonomic equipment request'. Intake received.

jamie_manager: Thanks for flagging, Kai. We'll support this. Marc, can facilities check stock for a height-adjustable desk + chair? If short, can we order?

marc_facilities: Filing ticket FCL-2026-1133. Short inventory on sit-stand desks this quarter due to supply delays. We can loan an interim desk riser and ship a lumbar cushion within 48 hours. Lead time to order new full desks is ~4 weeks.

kai: Loaner desk riser + cushion would help short-term. If it helps approval, my doc included note about reduced sick days if I have ergonomic setup.

olga: quick note — we already promised the last available sit-stand to a colleague returning from surgery next week. Also finance capped one-off desk purchases this month.

ops-finance: confirm budget cap this month for discretionary furniture. We can approve urgent medical equipment if HR/legal sign-off deems it reasonable. Please submit cost estimate.

priya_hr: Kai please complete the confidential intake and upload any supporting doc (you can DM). HR will draft the accommodation letter and evaluate reasonable options. If temporary measures suffice, HR can approve them faster.

leah_legal: Reminder: document offered options and employee preference. Medical need shouldn't be penalized. If budget is constrained, explore temporary reasonable alternatives (riser, cushion, schedule adjustments) and record the inability to procure immediately in the case file before denying.

jamie_manager: I'll reserve the loaner riser and lumbar cushion for Kai and reassign the scheduled sit-stand delivery for next month if needed. Kai — do you need help with setup or a short ergonomic consult?

kai: A consult would be great. If the riser helps, I can wait for a full desk. Appreciate the fast response.

marc_facilities: Riser and cushion reserved; ticket FCL-2026-1133 updated. ETA delivery tomorrow. Ordering queue for full desk placed; will advise timeline.

priya_hr: Next steps: 1) Kai to DM medical docs or confirm intake complete; 2) Facilities delivers interim kit (riser + cushion); 3) HR drafts accommodation letter indicating interim measures and plan to revisit in 30 days; 4) Finance to approve urgent purchase if needed after HR review. Target initial resolution: 3 business days.

olga: thanks for coordinating. small ask — let's log who gets what so we avoid double-booking the loaner gear.

jamie_manager: agreed, i'll keep the spreadsheet and update the team. Closing public thread when letter signed. DM for any sensitive docs.
